items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He got [Bruce] Lundvall to sign him for one record, unbelievable.

ctx.x: Do tell him I said hello.

I will. I’ll e-mail him tonight. In fact I just got a New Year’s greeting from him. He became – went into real estate. But he’s – now – he sent me in the last six months a few rap tunes that he did. They’re really great. Because he was always a very soulful cat. He was very honest. He made that one record on Columbia. He got [Bruce] Lundvall to sign him for one record, unbelievable. What it Is? No, something with You Could Hear Me Now [Whatcha Gonna Do for Me?]. He had Jimmy Cobb on it and everything like that,…
